Fairlead 1.2.2 adds drag-to-reorder for tunnels, pushes system DNS through the tunnel so ISP resolvers cannot poison answers, and fixes Windows list drag and build issues.

## Both platforms

- Drag tunnels in the sidebar to reorder them
- Duplicate a tunnel from the row or detail menu
- While connected, system DNS is pointed through the tunnel so LAN / ISP resolvers cannot poison Chrome, curl, and other apps that use the OS resolver
- UI copy and translation updates

## Windows

- Tunnel list drag no longer leaves a ghost row or overlaps neighbors while reordering
- Windows helper builds cleanly again with the system DNS changes
